release_notes:
• Fixed: training progress could be wiped by a single bad setting
• Learn now drills only characters you have been taught
• Flashing-light warning, plus screen flash brightness control
• Mic Ear no longer listens over other screens or hears the app itself
• Microphone failures are reported instead of silently freezing
• Turning off adaptive decoding restores your set speed
• Clearer text and colours in the light theme
• Camera permission no longer requested
• Update prompt can always be dismissed
